title: Windows Update will soon revert problematic drivers automatically
snippet: Microsoft is implementing a new initiative to automatically revert problematic drivers and prevent driver problems before they happen.

title: Tech companies lobbied away stricter rules on gas-powered data centers
snippet: A corporate climate watchdog has dropped a rule proposal around clean energy certificates after tech companies lobbied against stricter regulations on gas-powered data centers.

title: US reportedly allows 10 Chinese companies to buy NVIDIA's coveted H200 AI chips
snippet: Reuters reports that the US has allowed 10 Chinese companies to purchase NVIDIA's H200 AI chips, though NVIDIA has yet to make any deliveries.

title: Apple backs Google after EU orders Android be opened up to AI rivals
snippet: Apple agrees with Google that opening Android to AI rivals would put European users' privacy and safety at risk.

title: Microsoft is retiring Copilot Mode on Edge, because everything is Copilot Mode now
snippet: Microsoft is retiring the specific Copilot Mode feature on Edge browser as Copilot functionality is now integrated throughout the browser.

title: Razer updates the Blade 18 with new chips, a specced-out model costs $7,000
snippet: The 2026 Razer Blade 18 laptop adds the Intel Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus processor, with high-end configurations reaching $7,000.

title: OpenAI brings its Codex coding app to mobile
snippet: OpenAI has integrated its Codex coding app directly into the ChatGPT mobile app, allowing users to access their coding projects on the go.

title: AI革命、安全威胁和开源演进 - 2026年5月14日科技新闻快讯

title: 研华刘克振罕见谈5年蓝图！为何他不做大模型、押宝AI第五层蛋糕？
snippet: 研华创办人刘克振罕见公开谈及公司未来5年蓝图，专注于AI边缘运算和工业应用，不参与大模型竞争，押注AI第五层蛋糕。
